The value of `in` at line 24 depends on what was assigned to it at line 19, which is the result of `zf.getInputStream( ze )`. This assignment happens before line 24, so the value of `in` used at line 24 does depend on the value that was assigned to it (which is the result of `zf.getInputStream( ze )`).
